newsitem.title: USA: Canadian natgas prices soften due to Wash. outage.
newsitem.headline: Canadian natgas prices soften due to Wash. outage.

text.p: Canadian natural gas prices continued to soften Tuesday due primarily to an unexpected gas compressor outage in southwestern Washington, market sources said.

Northwest Pipeline, a unit of Williams Cos, said it will shut its Chehalis compressor station in Washington on Wednesday for about two weeks. About 130 mmcfd out of a total of 620 mmcfd of gas will be affected, the company said.
As a result of the outage, gas will be backed up at the export point, thereby pushing prices more than 10 cents lower to $1.23-1.31 per million British thermal units (mmBtu).
